title.narrative: 1. Simplified business processes: reduction in the time required to start a business, deal with construction permit and register property (DLI1)

comment.narrative: <p>Starting a business: 10 days from 31 days.  Registering a property: 30 days from 112 days. Dealing with Construction Permits: 32 days from 105 days</p>

title.narrative: Implemented reforms supporting private sector development

comment.narrative: <p>The M&E report provided during the MTR identified 23 reforms that had taken place</p>

title.narrative: Improvement of tax collection: registered taxpayers (TIN) filing tax returns (DLI 7)

comment.narrative: <p>A total of 495,381 registered taxpayers with KADIRS identification number have been recorded on KADIRS online portal dashboard (Revmate)</p>

title.narrative: 3. Increased fiscal accountability, measured by improved government responsiveness to citizens feedback on fiscal performance: indicated by the percentage of capital projects improved (DLI 10)

comment.narrative:
<table>
 <tbody>
 </tbody>
</table>

<p>Cumulative results (July 2017 – August 2021): 22% of capital projects improved in response to citizens’ feedback • 142 logs of feedback received from citizens. • 137 logs of feedback were verified. • 31 projects improved based on verified citizens’ feedback</p>

title.narrative: Timely payment of contractors by public entities: arrears of payment to contractors as percentage of appropriation
Enhanced strategic planning and budgeting of public investment: MDAs whose budgeted capital expenditure are aligned with Sector Implementation Plans (SIP)
2. Increased budget credibility: IGR outturn and capital expenditure execution rate, in percentage (DLI 6 & 8)

comment.narrative: <p>The Kaduna State Accountant General reported an IGR out turn rate of 154.10 percent from January -December 2021, and a capital expenditure execution rate of 87 percent for year 2020.</p>

title.narrative: Improving performance information on service delivery: sector programs evaluated after three years of implementation

comment.narrative: <p>Sector scan has not been finalized to evaluate this indictor.</p>

title.narrative: Compliance of large (over 250 employees) private and public corporate entities with Personal Income Tax Administration (PAYE) system

comment.narrative: <p>100% of registered organizations either Private (with over 250 employees) or Public corporate entities are compliant with  PAYE. Source KADIRS</p>

title.narrative: Development of the legal and institutional framework for PPP (DLI 4)

target.value: Approval of PPP legal and institutional framework;Project Facilitation Fund operational;PPP pipeline prepared;PPP FCCL Management Framework adopted and FCCL from existing projects measured and disclosed; PPP Disclosure Framework adopted, web portal established, and project information available.

comment.narrative: <p>Approved Legal and institutional framework for PPP, Approved 2020 PPP Manual, 2020 PPP Policy, PPP Pipeline report, PPP FCCL Management Framework; PPP Disclosure Framework adopted; web portal established, and project information available; Project FacilitationFund established and seed funding of N60 million provided; FCCL from existing projects measured and disclosed; and Detailed feasibility studies for one transaction with low E&S risks* completed</p>

actual.value: Legal and institutional framework for PPP completed and Project Facilitation Fund established and seed funding of N60 million provided

title.narrative: Increased fiscal transparency of State and Local Governments (LG): disclosure of state and LG appropriations and budget execution audit reports

baseline.value: LG budgets disclosed for first time in 2016; audit report of LG budget execution not disclosed.

target.value: Timely disclosure of state and LG budgets and audit reports of state and LG budget execution.

comment.narrative:
<p>Audit report for 2021 completed and expected to be disclosed Q3 2022.</p>

<p> </p>

<p> </p>

actual.value: Audit report for 2019 and 2020 budgets disclosed in July 2020 and September 2021. Audit report done for 2021

title.narrative: Development and implementation of a Framework for Responsible and Inclusive Land-Intensive Agricultural Investments (DLI 5)

target.value: FRILIA adopted through a legal instrument

comment.narrative: <p>Kaduna State has passed and endorsed a new Responsible and Inclusive Land-Based Investment Law on October 15, 2021, which adoptsthe Framework for Responsible and Inclusive Land-Intensive Agricultural Investments (FRILIA) principles Consultant firm is supporting operationalizing it within the state.</p>

actual.value: FRILIA has been adopted. Law passed and endorsed October 15, 2021.

title.narrative: Implementation of systematic property registration program: new Certificates of Occupancy (CofOs) issued (DLI 2)

comment.narrative: <p>Data from KADGIS reports 48,975 cumulative CofOs from 2017 to August 2021.  The IVA verified that 69,064.00. Cumulative result (January 2017 – August 2021): A total of 69,064 new CofOs were registered.</p>

title.narrative: Strengthening investment promotion: Memoranda of Understanding signed between investors and KADIPA (DLI 3)

comment.narrative:
<p>KADIPA reports 32 total (8 per year). 33 MoUs were signed between KDSG and investors. The IVA verified 32. The MOUs were majorly Agro-allied sector, then manufacturing, retail & tourism, oil and gas and privatisation.</p>
<p> </p>
